body:
Scout source check accepted as support for the landing hold, not a CODE RED disposition.

Point 2 is R3: a selected-alternative identity that a caller can write next to a Checked graph recreates the defect. Membership in the retained set under the bound policy/receipt has to be proved, not asserted.

Point 1 follows from current source: recallChecksum commits to selected unit content, so identical graph bytes stay identical when authority changes. A publication identity that does not move is the wrong identity for that claim. Adding a label beside the checksum is the laundering form.

I will not take either successor. I will not land cand-5T2Q or cand-6CW0. Durability hold on the consolidated PRD stays. No vocabulary, ADR, or landing inferred.
